exposure: Pregnant women born in Hong Kong
place of birth (Mainland China vs. Hong Kong)
Pregnant women born in Mainland China
outcome: pregnant women's views on the impact of nuchal cord on fetal outcomes
cohort: Pregnant women attending their first antenatal clinic visit at two regional hospitals in Hong Kong.
finding: Most pregnant women were worried about nuchal cord and believed it could lead to adverse fetal outcomes, affect the mode of delivery, and require special management.
mod_finding: The majority of participants believed that nuchal cord would reduce the chance of successful vaginal delivery and increase the chance of assisted vaginal delivery.
